title: Evaluation under duality
statement: Let a gate have all its input indices within the given Boolean value list, and suppose that if the gate is a negation gate then it has exactly one input. Then evaluating its dual gate on the list obtained by negating every value gives the negation of the original gate's evaluation.
hypotheses_covered: Every input index of the gate is less than the length of the Boolean value list
If the gate is a negation gate, its input list has length one
A gate and a Boolean value list
